$comment: Seeds = the sources EspAtlas Jr. (our autonomous data-maintainer) watches every day. It reads these, notices what changed, and opens a cited PR; a human merges. ADD YOUR OWN: append an entry below in a one-file PR — an awesome-list, a firmware repo, a vendor catalog, a subreddit. Official/machine-readable sources preferred; no ToS-violating scraping. See SPEC-data-maintainer.md + SPEC-discovery.md.

board_catalogs.note: Espressif's official versioned board index (+ boards.txt per platform for build.mcu/variant)
Device × chip × added-in-version table; known-good recipe candidates, already chip-mapped
Per-SoC datasheet PDFs — DC-Characteristics table is the ONLY citable source for soc.drive (per-pad GPIO source/sink mA); see SPEC-io-power.md §3/§5.1

M5Stack per-board spec pages — source for board.io (gpio_exposed 'IO ×N + pin list') and power_out.rail_ma_max ('Grove/rail max output current'); INCONSISTENTLY published, cite-or-omit per SPEC-io-power.md §3/§5.2

Per-SoC (dropdown) schematic-checklist — strapping pins + IO MUX pin-function table as machine-readable text ('GPIO8/9/25 are strapping pins'). OFFICIAL source for soc.reserved_pins (the gpio_free subtraction rules); see SPEC-io-power.md §3/§5.3. URL pattern per SoC: .../esp-hardware-design-guidelines/en/latest/<socslug>/schematic-checklist.html (socslug = esp32, esp32c3, esp32c61, esp32s3, esp32s31, …)
Adafruit's official versioned board index (Feather / QT Py / Metro ESP32-S2/S3) — machine-readable, gold source for Adafruit boards
Heltec's official ESP32 board index (WiFi LoRa 32, Wireless Tracker/Paper/Stick) — machine-readable
LilyGO catalog (T-Display, T-Deck, T-Beam, T-Watch); no Arduino index (rides the Espressif core) — board specs + pinouts from product pages and the Xinyuan-LilyGO GitHub org
Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32 series (C3/S3/C6) wiki — spec + pinout pages
DFRobot FireBeetle / Beetle ESP32 boards — wiki spec pages
Waveshare ESP32 dev boards (ESP32-S3-Touch, ESP32-C6, …) — wiki spec pages

firmware_releases.note: Espressif esp-claw — official project, firmware/recipes candidate
ESP32/ESP8266 device firmware (MQTT/Home Assistant, huge install base)
Bitaxe ESP32-S3 open-source Bitcoin miner firmware

community_signal.note: Curated firehose of ESP projects (with-code gate applies)
Trending posts that LINK A REPO (with-code gate)
HN stories that link a repo (with-code gate)

Launcher/M5Burner community firmware catalog (~2650 entries, ~1487 with a github link). DISCOVERY ONLY — never bulk-ingest (would break the trust bar, SPEC-data-population §1). Each entry carries github+category+esp target; the with-code gate (SPEC-discovery §3) drops the ~44% with no repo and the hobby/one-off noise, surfacing real repo-backed firmware (e.g. geo-tp/esp32-bus-pirate, jaylikesbunda/ghost_esp, 7h30th3r0n3/evil-m5project).

registries.note: PlatformIO Registry API — libraries/platforms/tools catalog; the esp32 query surfaces firmware/library candidates (with-code gate applies; exact query params an implementation detail)
ESP Component Registry — official Espressif ESP-IDF managed-components catalog
